items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-28
items.q: That's the most really Frank Daryl looked over, playing with Louis Dumain, taking interest.

ctx.x: One thing I was wondering about, where do breaks come from? Where does the idea of a break come from? You know, like a two-ball break? All the rhythm stops and this time, you know, you seem to have a little break in them.

He never caters. The only friend caters to looking at a piece of music is when slides came up. Everybody was dropping a valve like he was trying to take interest in reading. He was playing with a fellow there. He had a fellow playing a trumpet player named Louis Dumain. And Louis would show him things. That's the most really Frank Daryl looked over, playing with Louis Dumain, taking interest. But Louis was trying to tell him a delicate fellow he went up. I'd like to hear how that first Panama was.
